|game_text=Deploy on table. You may forfeit non-lightsaber weapons (using forfeit value = 3); place your just forfeited weapon in Used Pile. During your deploy phase, if you just deployed a vehicle or starship, may deploy a weapon (for free) on that vehicle or starship from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The [[Inconsequential Losses (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon) (Original 2005)|2005 original wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. The remaster gives permission to forfeit your non-lightsaber weapons at value 3 and recirculates just-forfeited weapons. The earlier wording sends non-lightsaber weapons to their owners’ Used Piles when lost. The later pull uses a singular action in a specified phase. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16602#page=3 Players Committee original sheet, p. 3, slip 39]. [[:File:VS9O-39-Inconsequential_Losses.png|Publisher slip]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards9.pdf#page=4 Players Committee remastered sheet, p. 4, slip 39]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 The period One Rule] still applies to singular on-table actions in a specified phase.
